verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AnythingLLM supports custom agent workflows and Agent Flows, but nothing shows those workflows running autonomously in the background, on a recurring schedule, or from event triggers without a user prompt. The automatic meeting transcription is a fixed built-in feature, not a user-configurable automation, so it does not count for this story. Workflows that a user must invoke are an adjacent capability, not background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
